subject: Re: Urgent—Dedicated fleet scarcity; proposal for mitigation and short-term prioritization
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@sabletech.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.example.com
Cc: Procurement (SableTech) <procurement@sabletech.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent—Q2 prod launch needs: request for reserved A100 capacity

Jordan —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. To be direct: our Q2 feature launch has slipped into the same week as another internal campaign and we now have a hard production date of May 15. We have a spike estimate (p95) that requires ~160k tokens/sec sustained during peak windows, which our infra team converted to a request for 8x A100-equivalent GPUs reserved in a single US region for three months.

We understand this is a material ask given existing commitments; SableTech is prepared to sign a short MOA (term + fees + SLA addendum) and provide a 30% prepaid deposit if Redwood can guarantee the reserved capacity and a mitigation clause if there are scheduling conflicts. Please advise next steps — we need to lock this by Apr 12 to keep our launch schedule.

Attachments: sabletech_demand_profile.csv (CSV) — see peak windows by hour.

Best,
Elena Park
Head of ML Infrastructure
SableTech


From: jordan_blake@redwood.example.com
To: Elena Park <elena.park@sabletech.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.example.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 4 Apr 2028 10:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent—Q2 prod launch needs: request for reserved A100 capacity

Elena —

Appreciate the clarity and the timeline. Short answer: we can probably meet the request but need to finalize a few internal tradeoffs first. I’m looping in Grace (sales ops) and Rishi (capacity lead) to outline options so we can give you a firm yes/no by the Apr 8 internal cut.

Proposed immediate steps from our side:
- Draft a short MOA and fee schedule (I’ll attach a template)
- Run a capacity feasibility check in us-west2 for the requested 8x A100-equivalent for May 15—Aug 15
- If conflicts exist, propose a mitigation: either (a) guaranteed 6x reserved + burstable pool to 8x for 2 hours/day, or (b) shift region to us-east1 with identical SLA.

Can you confirm whether SableTech is flexible on region or requires strict us-west2 pinning? Also confirm whether the 30% deposit is acceptable to secure negotiation priority.

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_moa_template_v2.pdf (PDF)
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com
To: jordan_blake@redwood.example.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.example.com, marcus_lin@redwood.example.com
Date: Wed, 5 Apr 2028 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent capacity check — SableTech (DEAL-8421)

Team —

I pulled the fleet reservations and short-term runway. Current committed capacity for May in us-west2 is tight: we have three large reserved deals that together occupy the equivalent of ~22x A100s and a planned hardware refresh that reduces available realized capacity by ~6x during a maintenance window May 10–17. That maintenance is our risk vector.

Options (tradeoffs spelled out):
1) Honor SableTech as requested (8x fixed reserve) — requires we temporarily reassign 8x from the near-term flexible pool. Impact: 12–24 hour latency in scaling for some queued inference jobs for existing mid-market customers; potential SLA credits exposure if preemptions affect their critical windows.

2) Offer 6x fixed + 2x burstable (2hr/day) — lower risk to others, but SableTech may not accept reduced headroom and could push for deeper financial concessions.

3) Swap commitments: move 8x from Deal-7112 (enterprise financial customer scheduled for onboarding May 18) into burstable status and keep SableTech fixed — this is politically sensitive; Deal-7112 has already signed onboarding dates and CS ramp plans.

Preliminary recommendation: pursue Option 2 while negotiating for the 30% deposit + a short penalty for failure to meet the burst window. If SableTech insists on strict us-west2 pinning and 8x fixed, escalate to leadership for a swap decision.

I’ve attached a short runbook and a capacity heatmap: capacity_runbook_v1.xlsx

Rishi
Capacity Planning Lead
Redwood Inference


From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@sabletech.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.example.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com
Date: Fri, 7 Apr 2028 14:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Updated SableTech proposal — 6+2 burst and MOA draft

Elena —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the demand CSV. We want to be a good partner and avoid any launch risk for you, so here’s the pragmatic proposal from Redwood:

1) Offer a 6x reserved A100-equivalent pool in us-west2 for May 15–Aug 15, guaranteed.
2) Provide an additional 2x burst capacity window (2 hours/day) to reach 8x during your peak windows.
3) SableTech would sign the attached MOA (term + fees) and provide a 30% deposit to lock the priority. MOA includes a failure-to-deliver clause with a capped credit equal to 1 week of fees, and an option to convert burst to fixed with 14 days' notice subject to availability.

If you can accept region-flexibility (we can also offer us-east1 as alternate with identical commercial terms) and sign the MOA by Apr 12, we’ll mark this as a priority reservation in our allocation system and schedule the capacity change to be active ahead of your May 15 date.

Please review MOA and confirm which region to bind.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sabletech_capacity_moa_draft.pdf

From: marcus_lin@redwood.example.com
To: jordan_blake@redwood.example.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 12 Apr 2028 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Leadership decision required — SableTech swap ask

Jordan / Rishi / Grace —

Per our leadership sync, SableTech is pushing hard for full 8x fixed and has rights under our standard enterprise play for priority if they prepaid. Deal-7112 leadership is raising objections to any swap: their onboarding schedule is customer-visible and moving them to burstable would risk a churn conversation.

We have two paths forward that leadership should choose between:
A) Approve an exception to reassign 8x from the flexible pool to SableTech for the May–Aug window and offer them a bespoke credit schedule (higher fee, shorter SLA credit cap) to compensate other customers; or
B) Maintain current commitments and accept SableTech's potential to escalate to executive procurement, offering them the 6+2 burst plan with an expanded legal warranty and priority support to reduce perceived risk.

I recommend Path B to preserve commitments and limit churn risk; Path A buys higher revenue but raises significant operational risk and precedent.

Leadership asked me to capture the decision and proposed language for exec approval. If you want, I can draft the brief for CEO sign-off.

Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

--

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@sabletech.com>, Procurement (SableTech) <procurement@sabletech.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.example.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 12 Apr 2028 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Final update — Redwood position on dedicated capacity for SableTech (DEAL-8421)

Elena / Procurement team —

Thank you for your patience while we ran the internal review. Redwood’s commercial and capacity teams have agreed on a pragmatic path to minimize launch risk while keeping our production commitments intact for all customers.

Final offer (requires signature by Apr 18 for implementation):
- 6x A100-equivalent reserved in us-west2 for May 15–Aug 15 (guaranteed).
- 2x additional burstable GPUs (2 hours/day) to reach 8x during your peak windows.
- 30% deposit required to secure scheduling priority.
- MOA includes a failure-to-deliver clause (capped credits) and a 14-day convertibility clause to request conversion of burst to fixed subject to availability.

If you need stricter region guarantees or a full 8x fixed commitment we will require executive-level approval and a commercial uplift; please indicate if you want us to pursue that escalation.

Please review the attached MOA and DocuSign link and let us know whether you accept the 6+2 arrangement or want us to escalate to leadership for a swap request.

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sabletech_capacity_moa_draft.pdf
DocuSign: https://docusign.net/reef/DEAL-8421
